headline: The Economy Borrowed More Than Citizens: Lending Activity Continued to Grow in Q2, National Bank of Serbia Publishes Details
summary: Lending activity in Serbia kept recording high year-on-year growth in the second quarter. Growth was 16.6% in June, slightly lower than in March, the National Bank of Serbia said.
why: Credit growth signals demand in the economy and is closely watched by the National Bank of Serbia when setting monetary policy. Strong borrowing can also raise financial stability questions.
